info.title: APInteract Backend API
info.summary: Public contract for APInteract frontend and backend communication.
info.description: This specification is the canonical source of truth for the APInteract backend API used by browser clients.

rules: The server emits system.ready immediately after upgrade.
The client must authenticate before sending domain commands.
A connection may replace an expiring access token for the same session.
A connection cannot switch to another user or session.
Blob bytes are transferred through authenticated HTTP operations.

Forbidden.description: The current user is not allowed to perform this operation.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist or is not visible.

TooManyRequests.description: The authentication attempt rate limit was exceeded.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The selected authentication provider is temporarily unavailable.

UtcDateTime.description: Canonical RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the invalid input.

proxyProtocolVersion.description: Proxy API protocol version, or null when the proxy health endpoint is unavailable.

fields.description: Provider-defined fields collected by the frontend.

baseUrl.description: Absolute HTTP URL template used as the root of composed request targets; blank disables composition until configured.

WorkspaceDeleteCommand.description: Owner-only deletion that removes the workspace from active access while retaining its immutable execution and audit history.

pathPrefix.description: An absolute HTTP(S) URL template when this collection is the first non-empty target component, or a path template appended to an earlier component.

CollectionDeleteResult.description: Identifies the complete persisted subtree removed by a recursive collection deletion.

CollectionDeleteCommand.description: Recursively deletes a collection, its descendant collections and requests, and their mutable profiles. Existing execution snapshots remain available.

includedEnvironmentIds.description: Ordered included environments from lowest to highest precedence. Omission creates an environment with no includes.
Complete ordered replacement from lowest to highest precedence. Omission preserves the current composition.

VariableProfileGetTemporaryCommand.description: Loads inherited variables for an unsaved request without creating persistent state.

ImportProviderId.description: Stable identifier of an import provider installed in the backend plugin host.

apiVersion.description: Breaking-compatibility generation of the host/plugin API; package releases use SemVer separately.

weight.description: Higher weights are presented before lower-weight plugin contributions.

ImportProviderManifest.description: Declarative capabilities for one installed source adapter.

CapturedExchangeView.description: An imported HTTP response capture that was not executed by APInteract.

ImportedRequestBodyOption.description: One provider-defined request body that may be selected before applying an import.

documentation.description: Provider-owned Markdown appended to request notes only when this option is selected.

ImportedCollection.description: A provider-created collection below the imported root.

ImportRequestBodySelection.description: Selects one provider-defined request body for an imported item.

ImportPlan.description: A mutation-free, source-neutral preview produced by one provider.

targetUrl.description: Absolute URL template or composed request-local path.

RequestExchangeListCommand.description: Lists persisted executions and imported captures owned by one request.

RequestExchangeGetCommand.description: Loads one selected immutable request-response exchange.

RequestDuplicateCommand.description: Creates an adjacent request with a fresh draft and cloned request-scoped variables, excluding execution and revision history.

targetUrl.description: Absolute URL template or composed request-local path.

RequestDeleteCommand.description: Deletes a mutable saved request and its variable profile after detaching any durable execution snapshots.

orderRevision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision shared by this sibling list.

value.description: Resolved ordinary value. Secret-derived and unresolved values are always null.

TemporaryRequestVariableProfile.description: An unsaved request's highest-precedence variable layer.

RequestVariableProfileUpdate.description: Optional request-variable mutation committed atomically with request draft updates.

inheritedVariables.description: Effective lower-precedence variables before this scope applies its local declarations.

EnvironmentVariableWrite.description: Creates a variable when variableId is omitted or updates the identified variable without changing its existing kind.

includedEnvironments.description: Directly included environments in low-to-high precedence order.

inheritedVariables.description: Effective workspace and included-environment variables before this environment applies its local declarations.

pathPrefix.description: An absolute HTTP(S) URL template when this collection is the first non-empty target component, or a path template appended to an earlier component.

inheritedTarget.description: Current composed workspace and ancestor-collection target prefix before this collection's local component.

effectivePath.description: Root-to-current collection target prefix. It may include an absolute URL established by the first non-empty collection component.

inheritedHeaders.description: Effective enabled headers inherited from the workspace and ancestor collections before this collection's local overrides.

effectiveHeaders.description: Effective enabled headers after applying ancestor and local collection profiles.

RequestBodyDefinition.description: Editable request body semantics before interpolation or attachment byte retrieval.

contentType.description: Optional body-owned media type applied as the effective Content-Type during execution.

FileRequestBody.description: An immutable uploaded file used as the complete binary request body.

contentType.description: Optional media type override; the attachment media type is used by default.

UrlEncodedRequestBody.description: Ordered text fields encoded as application/x-www-form-urlencoded after interpolation.

MultipartRequestBody.description: Ordered multipart/form-data text fields and immutable file attachments.

contentType.description: Optional media type override without a boundary parameter; the persisted boundary is appended during execution.

RequestAttachment.description: Immutable workspace-owned upload metadata referenced by request bodies or multipart file fields.

MultipartFileField.description: One uploaded file positioned among multipart text fields.

targetUrl.description: Absolute URL template in absolute mode, or a path-only template in composed mode.

inheritedTarget.description: Current composed workspace and collection target prefix before the request-local path.

inheritedHeaders.description: Effective enabled headers inherited from the request's collection ancestry before request-local overrides.

requestBody.description: Preferred semantic body definition. Older responses may omit it, in which case clients use the legacy body projection.

RequestExchangeSummary.description: Compact metadata for one persisted request-response record.

source.description: APInteract for executions, otherwise the import-provider ID that supplied the capture.

label.description: Optional provider-defined label for an imported capture.

RequestExchangeView.description: One selected exchange projected for immutable response display.

scriptVariableWrites.description: Value-free receipts for persistent variable writes committed with this execution.

OutgoingRequestView.description: Secret-redacted representation of the materialized request handed to the proxy. It is absent when execution fails before proxy dispatch.

derived.description: Whether the value is simulated from final transport semantics rather than supplied as a proxy header field.

truncated.description: Whether the displayed value is only a bounded prefix of the outgoing body.

targetUrl.description: Absolute URL template or composed request-local path.

sequence.description: One-based production order across script logs and tests for this execution.
One-based production order across script logs and tests for this execution.

code.description: Stable SDK/runtime code or JavaScript error name, when available.

line.description: One-based source line reported for the test body failure.

column.description: One-based source column reported for the test body failure.

messageCode.description: Stable localization key for an SDK-generated test message. Omitted for script-authored messages.

ScriptVariableWriteResult.description: Identifies one persistent variable write without exposing its value.

mode.description: Whether this header-value pair replaces same-name values from older scopes or appends to them.
